description.value: The Shady Tree is the only neighbourhood pub in Squamish, located on Highway 99 in the Garibaldi Highlands — a natural stop between downtown Squamish and Whistler on the Sea-to-Sky corridor. It has won multiple local awards including best pub and best appetizers and wings as voted by Squamish residents in 2018/2019. The kitchen prepares all food on premises and pairs a wide menu of burgers, mains, and salads with 15 beers on tap and over 35 bottled options.

address.value: 40456 Government Road, Garibaldi Highlands (Squamish), BC V0N 1T0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at shadytree.pub is fully functional and confirms an active neighbourhood pub at 40456 Government Road, Garibaldi Highlands, Squamish. Vegetarian options are explicitly named on the menu ('Full of Veggies Burger VEGETARIAN', 'Shady Glory Bowl') and the website states takeout exists by implication ('only for dine in not for take out') and via a home delivery service mention. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
